clause: local parent bulk action alphabet is declared before variation
formal_test: S_bulk belongs to Alg[g,e,omega,Hilbert matter,EM,topological kappa,quotient fields] and not to an algebra enlarged by M_cell, R_obs, P_active, finite J, labelled species, or marker auxiliaries
derivation: An action inventory is a grammar statement: if a symbol is not in the allowed local bulk alphabet, no local monomial containing that symbol can be projected out of S_bulk.
if_signed: marker bulk ideal is empty at the action-algebra level

derivation: The 4475 lambda_M law becomes an ideal-membership test. If the projection of S_bulk onto the marker ideal is zero, every bulk lambda_M coefficient is zero.
if_signed: lambda_M_bulk=0 for all marker monomials, not just the first guessed operator

clause: readout variables live only in O_read or J=0 diagnostic insertions
formal_test: R_obs appears in O_read[Phi;R_obs] or int J O_read with J=0 before local variation, never in S_bulk
derivation: This imports the 4474 lemma into the action grammar: external readout can label observations but cannot create an action coefficient.
if_signed: R_obs cannot source lambda_M, C_marker, c_R2_marker or T_marker

clause: finite-source, spurion, auxiliary and boundary substitutes are absent or routed
formal_test: J_finite=0, P_active not a background/spurion, no hidden M_aux integrates out, and Pi_loc(delta S_boundary/delta marker)=0
derivation: A proof that explicit lambda_M is absent is insufficient if the same operator is regenerated by a finite diagnostic source, material background, hidden auxiliary sector, or boundary/interface variation.
if_signed: the lambda_M zero theorem is not bypassed by another marker channel

clause: if the inventory signature is not signed, the finite branch projects into local residuals
formal_test: Pi_{I_M}(S_bulk)!=0 implies lambda_M rows must map to c_R2_marker, C_marker, T_marker/J_marker and boundary_marker without cancellation
derivation: This is the useful fallback: failed zero proof does not end the route; it makes the finite coupling scoreable in R10, PPN, WEP, clock and orbital arenas.
if_signed: finite marker branch becomes a bounded local-test branch

clause: parent inventory is not signed yet, so projection map is mandatory
formal_test: PAI4476_0 through PAI4476_3 sign together, or the projection fallback PAI4476_4 is used
derivation: Current MTS has a clean conditional inventory route, but not a signed parent action alphabet. Therefore 4476 supplies the finite projection map rather than pretending the branch is closed.
if_signed: lambda_M zero branch can advance toward local-GR closure
